extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors and people attempting to create a new Wikipedia article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating a new Wikipedia article (here: a proposed 'Sikh humor' page), including account requirements, searching for existing content, and use of the article-draft workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in and autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly; consider other options such as the article wizard or submitting a draft for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), use the article wizard or submit a draft so experienced editors can review and publish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing pages or alternative titles first
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Sikh humor' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can show whether content already exists elsewhere or whether a redirect would be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware of delays and check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created it may not be visible yet because of a delay; if the page has been deleted, check the deletion log.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you don't see a just-created page, wait a few minutes or try the purge function. If the title was deleted, consult the deletion log to understand why before recreating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider capitalization and redirects for titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use correct capitalization and add redirects where appropriate so readers searching variant spellings/ capitalizations find the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use appropriate tools and navigation (search, purge, request pages)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the available Wikipedia tools: search, article wizard, purge, and 'request a new article' workflows to manage the page creation process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These tools help manage visibility delays, draft submission, and community review; follow Wikipedia's established workflows rather than creating ad-hoc pages when restricted.
